scope: All @app.{get,post,put,patch,delete,route} decorators in app.py, routes_jobs.py, routes_lidarr.py, routes_setup.py, routes_submissions.py
auth_model: Global Flask before_request guard (app.py _enforce_security_boundary); exact endpoint+method public allowlist (_AUTH_PUBLIC_ENDPOINTS); narrower pre-setup-only allowlist (_FIRST_RUN_PUBLIC_ENDPOINTS); owner/admin bearer token, Basic auth, or session cookie.
limitations: Mechanically derived from decorators via AST parsing, cross-referenced against the real allowlist constants in app.py -- auth_required/csrf_required/changes_state are ground truth, not estimates.

security_classification/purpose/destructive_or_high_impact/rate_limit_required/existing_security_tests are read from security/endpoint_review_manifest.json (a separate, hand-reviewed file this script only ever reads, never writes) for routes that already exist there; routes not yet in that manifest are marked 'NEEDS_REVIEW' in those fields rather than guessed -- see needs_review_route_count below.
Static inventory does not prove object-level authorization or every helper a route calls.
